Remaining

Callouts

Current Quarto callouts are functional but not ideal.

Problems

  • Key Idea uses an exclamation icon that feels like a warning.
  • Looking Ahead currently shares styling with other callouts.
  • We would like custom icons and colors rather than Quarto defaults.

Desired appearance

Key Idea - soft yellow - star icon (or similar non-warning icon)

Predict - light blue - question icon

Try It - light green - play icon

Common Mistake - light amber - warning triangle

Looking Ahead - light lavender - forward arrow

Lessons learned

Attempting to override Quarto callouts with CSS produced inconsistent results (headers, bodies, and borders no longer matched).

Recommendation

Rather than continuing to patch CSS, investigate the Quarto-supported approach for customizing callouts (possibly SCSS or custom callout classes).

Until then, keep the existing Quarto callouts.

Future task:

Decide whether to (a) Customize Quarto callout theme properly (preferred) OR (b) Create completely custom callout classes
